blocks.text: Yeh bari (large-scale) mutations hain jin mein genes ki jagah badal jati hai, ya chromosomes ki banawat ya tadaad badal jati hai. Aisi mutations aam taur par khud ba khud (spontaneous) hoti hain. Chromosomal mutations ki qismein yeh hain:
1- Chromosome ki banawat (structure) mein tabdeeli

Chromosomal rearrangements (tarteeb ka badalna): chromosomes mein jismani tabdeeliyan aa sakti hain, jaise deletion (hissa nikal jana), duplication (hissa dohra ho jana), inversion (hissa ulat jana) aur translocation (hissa doosri jagah chala jana). Aam taur par yeh tabdeeliyan DNA double helix ke do mukhtalif jaghon se tootne se hoti hain. Translocation mein aik chromosome ka tukra doosre chromosome ka hissa ban jata hai. Inversion mein chromosome ke kisi hisse ka rukh ulat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Pattiyon wale chromosomes ke chaar hisse, har aik Before aur After. Deletion: dabbe wala neela hissa gum. Duplication: dabbe wala neela hissa do baar. Translocation: chromosome 4 aur chromosome 20 ke dabbe wale sire jagah badal lete hain. Inversion: do toot ke darmiyan ka hissa ulat jata hai, rangeen pattiyan ulti tarteeb mein. Har chromosome ka centromere qaim rehta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.24: Chromosomal rearrangements (kitab ki Figure 19.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Insertional inactivation: chromosomes ke bohat se chhote tukre genome mein aik jagah se doosri jagah ja sakte hain; DNA ke in chalne phirne wale tukron ko transposons ya jumping genes kehte hain. Transposons apni nayi jagah ittefaqan (random) chunte hain. Kuch transposons genes ke andar ghus kar unhein bekaar (inactivate) kar dete hain. Mutation ki yeh qisam qudrat mein aam hai, aur bohat si insani genetic bimariyan isi transposition ka nateeja hain. Maslan aik insani transposon X chromosome par clotting factor IX ke gene mein ghus kar gene ke beech mein stop codon bana deta hai, jis se X-linked haemophilia hota hai.
2- Chromosomes ki tadaad mein tabdeeli (chromosomal aberrations)

Kabhi kabhi meiosis mein chromosomes (kitab ke alfaaz mein sister chromatids) theek se alag nahin hote, aur gamete mein aik chromosome zyada ya kam aa jata hai. Is haalat ko non-disjunction kehte hain. Agar aisa gamete zygote banaye to bachche mein shadeed kharabiyan ho sakti hain. Non-disjunction autosomes mein bhi ho sakti hai aur sex chromosomes mein bhi. Non-disjunction se hone wali bari kharabiyan yeh hain:

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text:
Eggs mein waqt ke saath non-disjunction ka khatra sperm se kaheen zyada hota hai.
Wajah yeh hai ke larki ki paidaish tak us ke tamam mustaqbil ke eggs prophase I tak pohanch chuke hote hain, yaani jab woh maa banti hai to us ke eggs ki umr bhi utni hi hoti hai jitni us ki apni. Is ke muqable mein mard rozana naye sperm banate hain. Is liye maa ki umr baap ki umr se zyada ahem hai.
1- Down syndrome

Is nashonuma ki kharabi (developmental defect) mein chromosomes ki kul tadaad 47 (2n+1) hoti hai. Ise sab se pehle 1866 mein J. Langdon Down ne bayan kiya, isi liye ise Down syndrome (pehle “Down’s syndrome”) kehte hain. Taqreeban har 750 bachon mein se aik ko Down syndrome hota hai. Yeh autosome jore 21 ki non-disjunction se hota hai, jo auraton mein egg bante waqt ho sakti hai: meiosis mein 21wan jora theek se alag nahin hota aur 24 chromosomes wala egg banta hai. Aisa egg normal sperm se fertilize ho to 47 chromosomes wala trisomy (aik chromosome teen baar) bachcha (larka ya larki) paida hota hai.

blocks.alt: Insani karyotype: chromosome jore 1 se 22 teen qataaron mein, centromere par seedh mein; chromosome 21 ki teen copies surkh daire mein; sex chromosomes X aur Y, ya X aur X.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.25: Down syndrome ka karyotype (kitab ki Figure 19.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Alamaat: zehni kamzori, ruki hui nashonuma, kamar aur gardan par zyada jild, chapte chehre ke naqoosh, chhota sar, chhoti gardan aur haath paon, oopar ko uthi hui aankhein, chhote kaan, kamzor muscles, bahar nikli zabaan aur dil ke nuqs. Down syndrome wale mard aam taur par baanjh (sterile) hote hain, aur auraton mein normal auraton ke muqable mein bachche paida karne ki salahiyat kam hoti hai.

Mutasir bachon ki achhi dekh bhaal se Down syndrome walon ki zindagi behtar ho sakti hai, maslan aam masail ki screening (jaanch), zaroorat ho to ilaaj, achha gharelu mahol, khaas taleem aur munasib dekh bhaal.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Agar XX egg X sperm se mile to larki mein 47 chromosomes aur XXX sex chromosomes honge. X ki is trisomy ko triple X syndrome kehte hain. Aisi larkiyon mein seekhne mein mushkilaat, lamba qad aur door door aankhein ho sakti hain. Woh bachche paida kar sakti hain aur un ki balooghat (puberty) normal umr par hoti hai.
2- Klinefelter syndrome

Agar maa mein meiosis ke dauran X chromosome ki non-disjunction ho to egg mein ya to dono X chromosomes (XX) aa jate hain ya koi sex chromosome nahin aata (ise O likhte hain). Agar XX egg Y wale sperm se fertilize ho to bachche ke sex chromosomes mein trisomy (XXY) hogi aur kul chromosomes 47 (2n+1 ya 44+XXY) honge. Aisi non-disjunction baap mein gametes bante waqt bhi ho sakti hai, jis se aisa sperm banta hai jis mein X aur Y dono hon (XY). Yeh sperm normal egg (X) ko fertilize kare to bhi bachche mein XXY ho sakta hai. Is haalat (XXY) ko Klinefelter syndrome kehte hain (American physician Harry Klinefelter ke naam par, jinhon ne ise 1942 mein pehli baar bayan kiya).

blocks.alt: Insani karyotype: chromosome jore 1 se 22 teen qataaron mein aur sex chromosomes X, X aur Y surkh daire mein; kul 47 chromosomes.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.26: Klinefelter syndrome ka karyotype (kitab ki Figure 19.26 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Mutasir bachche bare ho kar baanjh mard bante hain jin mein kai zanana khasiyatein hoti hain (maslan jism par kam baal, chhati ka barhna), chhote testicles, aur jism ke hisson ka ghair normal naap (lambi taangein, chhota dhar, aur kandhe koolhon jitne chaure). In ki awaaz utni bhaari nahin hoti. Ilaaj mein testosterone dena (balooghat ke waqt testosterone ki kami poori karne ke liye) aur chhati ka operation shamil hai. Bolne ki mushkilaat, school ki mushkilaat aur logon se milne julne mein madad ke liye behavioural therapy di jati hai.
3- Turner syndrome

Agar bina X chromosome wala egg (O) normal Y sperm se mile to OY zygote aage nahin barhta, kyun ke insan X chromosome ke genes ke baghair zinda nahin reh sakta. Lekin agar O egg normal X sperm se mile (ya O sperm normal X egg se) to zygote se 45 chromosomes (XO ya 2n-1 ya 44+XO) wali larki banti hai, yaani sex chromosomes mein monosomy (aik chromosome kam). Mutasir larki baanjh hoti hai aur is haalat ko Turner syndrome kehte hain (American endocrinologist Dr. Henry Turner ne ise 1938 mein pehli baar bayan kiya).

Bari alamaat: chhota qad, jaali daar (webbed) gardan, kachche jinsi aaza aur baanjhpan, aur chhoti thodi aur jabra. Zyada tar Turner syndrome wali larkiyon ki zehanat normal hoti hai, kabhi kabhi seekhne ki khaas mushkilaat ke saath. Turner syndrome ke saath sehat ke kai masail bhi ho sakte hain, jaise jigar aur gurde ke masail, motapa, diabetes aur high blood pressure. Yeh taqreeban har 2500 larkiyon ki paidaish mein aik baar hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Turner syndrome ki shareh (frequency) taqreeban 5000 larkiyon mein aik chhapi hai. Sahi adad taqreeban 2500 larkiyon mein aik hai (tibbi hawale 2000 se 2500 mein aik batate hain). Kitab alamaat mein 'low mental abilities' (kam zehni salahiyat) bhi likhti hai; asal mein zyada tar ki zehanat normal hoti hai, kabhi khaas seekhne ki mushkilaat ke saath.

Growth hormone ke ilaaj se qad barh sakta hai; agar yeh ilaaj bachpan mein jaldi shuru ho jaye to mutasir larki poore qad tak pohanch sakti hai. Secondary sexual characteristics (balooghat ki nishaniyon) ki nashonuma ke liye estrogen replacement therapy di jati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen, egg banne mein nondisjunction: XX cell se O egg aur XX egg; normal X ya Y sperm se milne par XO (larki, Turner syndrome), OY (zinda nahi rehta), XXY (larka, Klinefelter syndrome) aur XXX (larki, XXX syndrome). Daen, sperm banne mein nondisjunction: XY cell se O aur XY sperm; normal X eggs se milne par XO (Turner syndrome) aur XXY (Klinefelter syndrome).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.27: Sex chromosomes ki nondisjunction (kitab ki Figure 19.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nondisjunction mein jore wale chromosomes alag nahi hote, is liye kuch gametes mein dono aur kuch mein koi nahi (O) aata. Aisa gamete normal gamete se mile to zygote mein sex chromosomes ek kam ya ek zyada hote hain: XO Turner, XXY Klinefelter, XXX triple X, aur OY zinda nahi rehta.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text:
Agar zygote mein aik autosome kam ho to woh nashonuma poori nahin kar sakta. Aik autosome zyada wale zyada tar zygotes bhi zinda nahin rehte. Lekin chromosome jore 13, 15, 18, 21 aur 22 mein teen chromosomes ho sakte hain aur insan kuch arsa zinda reh sakta hai. Jore 13, 15 ya 18 mein izafi chromosome shadeed nashonuma ki kharabiyan karta hai aur aise bachche chand maheenon mein mar jate hain.
Is ke baraks jin logon mein chromosome 21 ya 22 ki izafi copy ho, woh aam taur par jawani tak zinda rehte hain. In ki haddiyon ki pukhtagi der se hoti hai, is liye woh aam taur par chhote qad ke aur kamzor muscles wale hote hain, aur in ki zehni nashonuma bhi mutasir hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne teen chromosomes wale jore “13, 15, 18, 21, and 2” chhape hain. Aakhri jora 2 nahin balke 22 hai, jaisa ke usi box ka agla paragraph khud kehta hai (“chromosome 21 ya 22”); chromosome 2 ki trisomy mein insan zinda nahin reh sakta.

blocks.prompt: 45 saal ki aurat mein 25 saal ki aurat ke muqable mein Down syndrome wala bachcha hone ka imkaan kyun zyada hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ke eggs paidaish se pehle hi prophase I tak pohanch kar ruke hue hain, yaani woh bhi 45 saal purane hain; eggs ki umr ke saath non-disjunction ka khatra barhta hai.

blocks.text: Fauri khulasa

items: Banawat ki tabdeeli: deletion, duplication, inversion, translocation; transposons genes bekaar kar sakte hain.
Tadaad ki tabdeeli: meiosis mein non-disjunction.
Down 47 (21 teen baar); Klinefelter 47 (XXY); Turner 45 (XO); triple X 47 (XXX); OY zinda nahin.
